testcase_name: Terminated or purged employees are excluded from anniversary list
test_objective: Verify employees with a termination record or purged status are excluded from the upcoming anniversaries feed even if their anniversary date falls within range.
preconditions: System initialized with baseline test fixtures
Authorized user session active
test_steps: 1. Set up a terminated employee and a purged employee both with anniversary dates within the next 30 days
2. Call GET /api/v2/buzz/anniversaries
3. Inspect response
expected_results: Neither the terminated nor the purged employee appears in the results.
